exposure: Trinity seamless care service (TSCS) with multidisciplinary diagnosis and treatment (MDT)
trinity seamless care service (TSCS) in patients with gestational diabetes with multidisciplinary diagnosis and treatment (MDT)
cohort: 200 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes through oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) at 24 to 28 weeks of gestation
finding: TSCS with MDT for gestational diabetes helps control weight gain and blood glucose, reducing maternal, perinatal, and neonatal complications, and improving pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was significantly lower in the observation group (TSCS with MDT) compared to the control group (P<0.05).
gest_age: 24 to 28 weeks at diagnosis of gestational diabetes
